text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2756 for the Senior Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes a computer science degree and experience listed with "Python" and "React". Key gaps include a lack of experience with vue.js, node.js, and aws, as well as having only 2.54 years of experience compared to the implied requirement. The application was escalated for manual review despite missing must-have requirements and a low overall fit score.
